name: DecisionsAI Dogfood Ticket
description: Dogfood loop for DecisionsAI: scope ticket, implement in harness, lint/test, Playwright verify on local server, self-assess with return contract.
kickoff:
Start the DecisionsAI dogfood ticket loop.
Goal: ticket implemented, Playwright proof on http://127.0.0.1:8765, harness return contract recorded
Max iterations: 5
Exit when: acceptance criteria met, unit/lint green, Playwright screenshots in result packet, return contract complete

loop_contract.name: DecisionsAI Dogfood Ticket
loop_contract.goal: ticket implemented with Playwright proof and harness return contract
loop_contract.exit_when: acceptance criteria met, tests green, Playwright screenshots attached, return contract complete
loop_contract.check_command: python3 -m unittest + Playwright UI check on /workflows/
guardrails: Do not skip Playwright verification for UI tickets
Do not mark complete without return contract fields
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace: implement → test → Playwright → self-assess → handoff.
loop_contract.step_1: Read ticket acceptance criteria, user journey, and developer_context before acting.

steps.name: Scope ticket and context
steps.instruction: Read linked ticket acceptance criteria, developer_context, and workspace pickup brief. Restate user journey and definition of done. Report using harness return contract.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on ticket scope
- List acceptance criteria explicitly
steps.validation_prompt: Ticket scope, acceptance criteria, and user journey are explicit.

steps.name: Implement in harness
steps.instruction: Implement the ticket slice in the linked project using harness pickup brief. Iterate: develop → test → correct → report return contract.
steps.guardrail:
- Minimal diff
- Run real project tests before reporting complete
steps.validation_prompt: Implementation matches acceptance criteria with tests run.

steps.name: Unit and lint gate
steps.instruction: Run discovered lint/unit commands from repo config (e.g. python3 -m unittest). Capture exact commands and output.
steps.validation_prompt: Lint/unit commands ran with pass/fail captured.

steps.name: Playwright verify DecisionsAI UI
steps.instruction: Run Playwright against http://127.0.0.1:8765 for the ticket user journey. Capture screenshots into result packet evidence.
steps.guardrail:
- Server must be running on 127.0.0.1:8765
- Attach screenshots to evidence
steps.validation_prompt: Playwright journey passed with screenshots attached.

config.code:
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
url = 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/workflows/'
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1440, 'height': 900})
    page.goto(url, wait_until='domcontentloaded', timeout=30000)
    page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    assert 'workflow' in page.url.lower() or page.locator('#wf-list, #wf-empty').count() > 0
    print('DOGFOOD_PLAYWRIGHT_OK: workflows page loaded')
    browser.close()

steps.name: Self-assessment and return contract
steps.instruction: Fill the full harness return contract (status, summary, tests_run, drift_check, security, ui_assessment, self_corrections, files_changed, blockers). Confirm definition of done met.
steps.guardrail:
- All return contract fields required
- Say handoff in DecisionsAI when done
steps.validation_prompt: Return contract complete; ticket ready to mark done.
